# Architect at Work

> > Architect at Work showcases contemporary architecture, adaptive reuse, and sustainable design through project features, interviews with emerging and established architects, and industry insights across Europe.

The platform highlights innovative architectural projects from practices like Cubículo, ATA, Baumschlager Eberle, and Ruumfabrigg, with particular focus on contextual design, historic preservation, and sustainable transformation. Content spans multiple European markets including Portugal, Switzerland, Germany, and the Netherlands, featuring both young architects and established figures like Le Corbusier and Philippe Starck.

## Key Topics

- Adaptive reuse and building transformation
- Contextual design and genius loci
- Historic preservation and urban infill
- Sustainable architecture practices
- Young architects and emerging practices
- Porto architecture and Portuguese design
- Swiss architecture (Zurich, Glarus Nord, ETH Zurich)
- Mies van der Rohe Award projects
- Flexible workspace design
- Residential and housing projects
- Circular construction methods
- Green infrastructure and water management
- Contemporary lighting design
- Building materials and facade solutions

## Adaptive Reuse & Sustainable Transformation

- [Transformation instead of new construction](https://www.architectatwork.com/nl/insights/inspiration/actua-transformation-instead-of-new-construction-1962982): Baumschlager Eberle's sustainable 1970s office renovation in Zurich
- [Transformation statt Neubau](https://www.architectatwork.com/de/insights/inspiration/actua-transformation-instead-of-new-construction-1962982): Baumschlager Eberle transforms 1970s Zurich office building sustainably
- [Adaptive Reuse Architecture](https://www.architectatwork.com/pt/insights/inspiration/adaptive-reuse-architecture-3576217): Circular construction and building reuse in Scandinavian architecture
- [ARCHITECTS TALKING ARCHITECTURE: With the Power of Place](https://www.architectatwork.com/cs/insights/inspiration/with-the-power-of-place-699340): Pascal Marx of Ruumfabrigg on adaptive reuse and genius loci in Swiss work
- [With the Power of Place](https://www.architectatwork.com/pt/insights/inspiration/with-the-power-of-place-699340): Ruumfabrigg's Pascal Marx discusses barn conversions and place identity
- [Territory changing its tune - green strategies for water management](https://www.architectatwork.com/pt/insights/inspiration/territory-changing-its-tune-green-strategies-for-water-management-698947): EU Nature Restoration Law and Turenscape's Sponge City water strategies

## Emerging Architects & First Works

- [First works: The Case of the General Silveira Building](https://www.architectatwork.com/pl/insights/inspiration/first-works-the-case-of-the-general-silveira-building-76914): Young architects Cubículo & ATA's General Silveira Building in Porto
- [First works: The Case of the General Silveira Building](https://www.architectatwork.com/de/insights/inspiration/first-works-the-case-of-the-general-silveira-building-76914): Cubículo & ATA's contextual housing project in Porto's historic center
- [New models for living in the city of Lisbon](https://www.architectatwork.com/nl/insights/inspiration/new-models-for-living-in-the-city-of-lisbon-76906): Lisbon's collective housing models and cooperative housing solutions
- [The volcano as an architectural host](https://www.architectatwork.com/pl/insights/inspiration/the-volcano-as-an-architectural-host-76490): VOL studio's Espai Crater museum integrated into volcanic landscape

## Contemporary Workspace & Hospitality Design

- [Flexible Workspace](https://www.architectatwork.com/es/insights/inspiration/flexibler-workspace-3575718): Christ & Gantenbein's flexible Roche office building near Basel
- [A new Starck hotel in the centre of Rome](https://www.architectatwork.com/pt/insights/inspiration/a-new-starck-hotel-in-the-centre-of-rome-3576223): Philippe Starck's new Brach hotel opening in Rome's historic center 2025

## Architectural Legacy & Theory

- [Le Corbusier, 60 Years of Legacy](https://www.architectatwork.com/cs/insights/inspiration/actua-le-corbusier-60-years-of-legacy-1882300): Le Corbusier's 60th anniversary exhibitions and architectural legacy
- [Interpreting light](https://www.architectatwork.com/en/insights/inspiration/interpreting-light-76933): Italian lighting designers Iannone & Tellini on neuroscience-based lighting

## Building Materials & Product Innovation

- [With every fibre](https://www.architectatwork.com/nl/insights/inspiration/with-every-fibre-698008): Cedral fibre cement facade solutions from Etex Exteriors
- [Design Statement with Redesigned, Iconic Switches: Niko Rocker and Niko Toggle](https://www.architectatwork.com/pt/insights/inspiration/design-statement-with-redesigned-iconic-switches-niko-rocker-and-niko-toggle-698738): Niko's premium Rocker & Toggle switches with smart home integration
- [Le service de conception sur mesure de modulyss séduit le designer Sylvain Willenz](https://www.architectatwork.com/fr/insights/inspiration/bespoke-design-service-from-modulyss-charms-designer-sylvain-willenz-698742): Designer Sylvain Willenz collaborates with modulyss on bespoke carpets
- [NOA Outdoor Living krijgt nieuwe dimensie](https://www.architectatwork.com/en/insights/inspiration/noa-outdoor-living-gains-a-new-dimension-698736): Deer's sustainable grass pavers featured at NOA Outdoor Living Kruisem
